These three components in openmrs-esm-patient-chart import `WarningIcon` from `@openmrs/esm-framework` and render it. I found them with a text search of the checkout for `WarningIcon`. I did not open the files or look at the `WarningIcon` definition in openmrs-esm-core, so I haven't checked how each one uses it beyond the `size={16}` prop.

1. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-medications-app/src/drug-order-basket-panel/order-basket-item-tile.component.tsx` imports it on line 5 and renders `<WarningIcon size={16} />` on line 91.
2. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-orders-app/src/order-basket/general-order-type/order-basket-item-tile.component.tsx` imports it on line 5 and renders it on line 38.
3. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-tests-app/src/test-orders/lab-order-basket-panel/lab-order-basket-item-tile.component.tsx` imports it on line 5 and renders it on line 46.
